metadata.title: EmbeddingBag max_norm parameter does not work

trigger_conditions.condition: Calling embedding_bag with optional parameter max_norm enabled, which activates an untested internal execution path and triggers an implementation exception.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Call torch.nn.functional.embedding_bag with max_norm set to a non-None value.

failure_behavior.description: Call torch.nn.functional.embedding_bag with max_norm set to a non-None value.
